All I've seen so far are kiddos who overhyped the game and now disappointed because the stuff they imagined to be in the game aren't there. That's pretty accurate. "Man, this combat in Minecraft sucks." The No Man's Sky complaints seem along those lines.

the biggest gripes I have seen people repeating are that the inventory is limited and that they are looking for the same things on each planet so it becomes repetitive.

I don't have the game so am curious what is there to do in the game? All I have heard is gather fuel and supplies for repairs then travel onward until you need to get more fuel/repairs.

The exploration aspect is actually pretty solid, or it would be if there was more content. The objective to keep travelling forward without looking back is quite fun if you're into that kind of thing, and is enough of an objective in itself. Or it would be if there was more content. At the moment there are so few upgrades to your ship and suit that you start finding duplicates after 10 hours which takes pretty much all the reward out of the game. There are the same 6 or 7 things on every single planet, if you're lucky you might find a trading post.

It's a crying shame that a game so massively huge and ambitious could be held back by lack of variation. There's not much point in exploring if you already know what you're going to find on every single planet. They need to implement some kind of system in which some things spawn once per game, per player. And the game needs more player levels and upgrades besides "this makes your gun shoot faster" and "this makes your shield stronger".

It is solid and good enough. Bought it on PC and although it's massively overpriced I've otherwise had no problems running it. The main issue the game has is lack of content - there's a massive sprawling galaxy full of proc gen planets, but a woefully inadequate amount of upgrades, ships, and points of interest. The writing is absolutely fantastic, someone did a very good job writing all the descriptions and encounters, but that is the only part of the game that isn't repetitive. The visual content needs to compliment the varied and interesting writing, not use it as a crutch.

It seems like they had to cut a ton of content from the final release, all the repetition just doesn't make sense otherwise. I really hope they address this in future updates because it's such a waste to have a huge universe with the same 20 things endlessly reoccuring in it. I'd love to see hundreds of new and interesting upgrades to your ship and exosuit, dark dungeons, derelict drifting hulks infested with spider aliens, bounty missions, tracking missions, treasure hunts, etc etc. The possibilities are almost endless.
